links.outcome: Emergency recall in urgency triage, baseline versus evolved programs
links.effect: Baseline emergency recall was 0.60, so emergencies were missed. Evolved programs raised it to 0.97, and Semigran accuracy rose from 77.3% to 87.1%.
links.quote: In triage, evolved programs increase Semigran accuracy from $77.3\%$ to $87.1\%$ and emergency recall from $0.60$ to $0.97$, while improving safety-weighted held-out MIMIC-ESI performance.

unlisted_practices: LLM-guided MAP-Elites evolutionary search over executable triage programs, consultation policies and prompts as an inference-time alternative to fine-tuning

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks an automated evolutionary search framework (LLM-guided MAP-Elites) to optimize decision pipelines and prompts on benchmark datasets (Semigran, MIMIC-ESI, iCRAFTMD, PneumoniaMNIST).
